main_text.l: Viri, eorúmque etiam discipuli. Hic enim
duo illa nomina plané eodem sensu acci-
pit, quo à tertij sæculi, & sequentium
Christianis ad hæc usque tempora acce-
mus: sic nimirum, ut duas dignitates à se
que is intelligatur, qui Presbyter quidem
ipse quoque est; sed & Presbyterio præest,
& in eorum Collegio caput est; Pres-
byter verò is sit qui Episcopo subest. Un-
de necessario exsurgunt tres in Ecclesiâ
bus, quarum prior usum ac consuetudi-
nem spectat Epistolici Ignatij in Episcopi
logo, qui in Epistolam ad Magnesianos[?]

page.notes: The first word "tet" is badly printed; it is probably "ter" with a damaged r, so it is marked [?]. The printed "p ro-bat" appears to be "pro-bat" with a stray "p" before the hyphen, which is kept as the printer's word split. The final word "Magnesianos" has a flourish at the line end, which may be a special abbreviation sign, so it is marked [?]. Italic runs follow the printed type. The "Digitized by Google" watermark at the bottom right is left out.
